description: PROP-BILL-056 env startup validation test (cross-cutting.test.ts lines 79-101) only tests that validateRequiredEnvVars() returns { ok: false }. It does NOT test that the process actually exits with non-zero code. There is no startup code in the implementation that calls validateRequiredEnvVars(), validateFixedEnvVars(), or validateFrontendBaseUrl() and then calls process.exit(). REQ-BILL-031 requires: 'SHALL exit with non-zero code if any validation fails.' The test merely validates the pure function output, not the actual process exit behavior.
